research.title: Adaptive Covariance Shrinkage for Unevenly Sampled Groups
bullets: Formulated whether partial pooling of covariance estimates could stabilize probabilistic classification when labeled observations are unevenly distributed across groups.
Led development of a groupwise shrinkage estimator and evaluated sensitivity to covariance heterogeneity using simulated data and held-out predictive likelihood.

research.title: Prediction Under Shifting Missingness Patterns
bullets: Formulated how changes in predictor missingness affect regression uncertainty, distinguishing shifts in missingness frequency from changes in observed feature distributions.
Led development of a pattern-weighted regression ensemble and compared uncertainty estimates against imputation baselines under controlled missingness shifts.

research.title: Stable Weighted Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Formulated how unstable density ratio estimates affect weighted conformal prediction, focusing on marginal coverage and interval width under covariate shift.
Led development of regularized weighting and calibration procedures; designed comparisons examining weight clipping, calibration sample composition, and subgroup coverage diagnostics.

work.title: Batch Data Validation and Reporting Maintenance
bullets: Implemented validation checks for incoming tabular records, handling missing fields, inconsistent types, and duplicate identifiers before scheduled reporting jobs.
Maintained data transformation routines and added regression tests for documented edge cases, coordinating fixes through code review and issue tracking.

projects.title: Regularized Linear Models for Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge, lasso, and elastic net regression with standardized preprocessing and cross-validation for datasets containing correlated and irrelevant predictors.
Compared predictive error and coefficient stability across resampled training sets, examining how regularization choices affected selection among correlated features.

projects.title: Approximate Bayesian Inference for Logistic Regression
bullets: Implemented Laplace approximation and mean-field variational inference for Bayesian logistic regression using a shared likelihood and Gaussian coefficient priors.
Compared predictive calibration, posterior dispersion, and optimization behavior on simulated classification data with varying class overlap and predictor dependence.

projects.title: Kernel and Nearest-Neighbor Two-Sample Testing
bullets: Implemented kernel maximum mean discrepancy and nearest-neighbor two-sample tests, using permutation procedures to estimate significance under a common evaluation protocol.
Compared rejection behavior under simulated location, scale, and mixture shifts, examining sensitivity to kernel bandwidth and neighborhood size.
